title: 2007 AMC 10A Problem 24
statement: Circles centered at \(A\) and \(B\) each have radius \(2,\) as shown. Point \(O\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{AB},\) and \(OA = 2\sqrt{2}.\) Segments \(OC\) and \(OD\) are tangent to the circles centered at \(A\) and \(B,\) respectively, and \(\overline{EF}\) is a common tangent. What is the area of the shaded region \(ECODF?\)

solutions.text:
Rectangle \(ABFE\) has area \(AE \cdot AB = 2 \cdot 4\sqrt2 = 8\sqrt2.\)

Right triangles \(ACO\) and \(BDO\) each have hypotenuse \(2\sqrt2\) and a leg of \(2,\) so each is isosceles right with area \(2.\)

Angles \(CAE\) and \(DBF\) are each \(45^\circ,\) so sectors \(CAE\) and \(DBF\) each have area \(\tfrac18 \pi \cdot 2^2 = \tfrac{\pi}{2}.\)

The shaded area is \[ \begin{gathered} 8\sqrt2 - 2 \cdot 2 - 2 \cdot \tfrac{\pi}{2} \\ = 8\sqrt2 - 4 - \pi. \end{gathered} \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The region is rectangle \(ABFE\) with two right triangles and two circular sectors removed
Each triangle formed by tangency is isosceles right with legs \(2;\) each sector has a \(45^\circ\) angle and radius \(2\)
